name: Absorptive
summaryLine: When you are wearing armor or wielding a shield with this property, damage that you take from weapons is reduced by an amount equal to the absorptive number.

name: Agile
summaryLine: While wearing armor or wielding a shield with this property, your Dexterity score becomes equal to the agile number.

name: Anchor
summaryLine: A shield with this property can be used to provide cover.

name: Avoidant
summaryLine: When wearing armor or wielding a shield with this property and a creature makes an attack against you, the critical hit range decreases by an amount equal to the avoidant number, to a minimum of 1.
